name: forge/github-read-file
description: Read the full content of a single file from a GitHub repository (up to 1 MB) from a branch, tag, or commit — defaults to the default branch. Requires the GITHUB_TOKEN secret and AI Forge's github_read_file builtin (ships with the backend).

tool.name: github_read_file
tool.description: Read the full content of a single file from a GitHub repository (up to 1 MB). Defaults to the repository's default branch.

owner.description: GitHub owner or organization of the repository

path.description: File path relative to the repository root

ref.description: Branch, tag, or commit SHA to read from; defaults to the repository's default branch
